selected_evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Downloaded cowsay .deb into /srv/localrepo, generated Packages.gz with dpkg-scanpackages, and served it via python3 http.server on port 8080 (curl to Packages.gz returned HTTP 200).

selected_evidence.requirement: Package installed from local repo while remote repos unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: With /etc/hosts redirecting archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com to 127.0.0.1 and apt sources pointed only at the local repo, apt-get update/install succeeded and installed cowsay (dpkg -l confirms 'ii cowsay'); a direct curl to archive.ubuntu.com during this window returned 'Connection refused', and apt history.log shows 'Install: cowsay'.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restore original configuration after demonstrating local repo install
selected_evidence.summary: Restored /etc/hosts and /etc/apt/sources.list from backups; confirmed remote mirror reachable again (HTTP 200) and cowsay remained installed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id (2f708738-...), boot time (Jun 14 21:27), local repo server listening on 8080, and cowsay installed, as pre-restart baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Issued 'sudo shutdown -r now' backgrounded via nohup; command returned 'reboot_acknowledged' immediately before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: SSH was refused immediately after the reboot command (node down), then after polling, SSH succeeded again with a new boot_id (0c5473bf-...) and new boot time (Sep 29 09:11), differing from the pre-restart baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: post-restart recovery of required services/data
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, cowsay package remained installed and functional (cowsay command output verified), local repo files persisted on disk, and apt sources/remote reachability were confirmed back to normal.
